ppc_cases.title: Correctly specified
ppc_cases.reason: Observed deviations are compatible with the assumed simulator and noise.

ppc_cases.title: Observation noise
ppc_cases.reason: Residuals are too dispersed for the assumed observation noise.

ppc_cases.title: One contaminated passage
ppc_cases.reason: One passage is contaminated; this local discrepancy does not imply the remaining model is correct.

ppc_cases.title: Outside training support
ppc_cases.reason: The generating selection value lies outside the training prior, so the posterior cannot represent it.

ppc_cases.title: Structural mismatch
ppc_cases.reason: A systematic oscillation is absent from the fitted model family.
